# Stealthis MCP Server — LLM Context

> Remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI agents access to the Stealthis
> library: 2,000+ production-ready, MIT-licensed UI components, animations, full page
> templates and design-system resources. Free, public, no API key, no account.

## Canonical facts

- Server URL (MCP Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.stealthis.dev/mcp
- Transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST (methods: initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list, tools/call). No SSE.
- Authentication: none. No API key, no OAuth, no account.
- Price: free. License of all content: MIT.
- Machine-readable summary: https://mcp.stealthis.dev/api
- Landing page (setup guide): https://mcp.stealthis.dev/
- Use cases and prompt examples: https://mcp.stealthis.dev/use-cases
- Full documentation: https://docs.stealthis.dev/mcp-server/
- Library website: https://stealthis.dev/library
- Live demos: https://lab.stealthis.dev/

## How to connect

### claude.ai (web) and Claude Desktop — custom connector (remote, nothing to install)
1. Copy the URL: https://mcp.stealthis.dev/mcp
2. Open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector (direct link: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector)
3. Name it "Stealthis", paste the URL, click Add. Leave OAuth fields empty.

### Claude Code (CLI)
    claude mcp add stealthis --transport http https://mcp.stealthis.dev/mcp

### Cursor and other JSON-configured MCP clients
    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "stealthis": {
          "type": "http",
          "url": "https://mcp.stealthis.dev/mcp"
        }
      }
    }

### Local development (only if hacking on the server itself)
Run the Cloudflare Worker locally (`bun run dev:mcp` in the monorepo) and point a client
at http://localhost:8787/mcp. Regular users should always use the hosted URL.

## Tools (5)

1. list_resources — list catalog resources. Optional args: category (web-animations, web-pages, ui-components, patterns, components, pages, prompts, plugins, architectures, boilerplates, remotion, database-schemas), difficulty (easy | med | hard), tech (e.g. "gsap", "css", "react"). Returns metadata: slug, title, description, category, difficulty, targets, tech, tags, labRoute, resourceUrl.
2. get_resource — full metadata for one resource. Required arg: slug. Returns metadata plus availableSnippets, resourceUrl (https://stealthis.dev/r/<slug>) and labUrl.
3. get_snippet — actual source code for a resource. Required args: slug, target (html | css | js | react | next | vue | svelte | astro | schema-sql | seed-sql | queries-sql | diagram-mmd | schema-dbml).
4. search — full-text search across titles, descriptions, tags, tech and category. Required arg: query.
5. get_lab — full-screen live demo URL for a resource on lab.stealthis.dev. Required arg: slug.

## Direct HTTP access (no MCP client required)

- GET https://mcp.stealthis.dev/tools/list_resources?category=&difficulty=&tech=
- GET https://mcp.stealthis.dev/tools/get_resource/<slug>
- GET https://mcp.stealthis.dev/tools/get_snippet/<slug>/<target>
- GET https://mcp.stealthis.dev/tools/search?q=<query>
- GET https://mcp.stealthis.dev/tools/get_lab/<slug>

## Example JSON-RPC calls

List tools:
    curl -s https://mcp.stealthis.dev/mcp -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'

Search:
    curl -s https://mcp.stealthis.dev/mcp -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":{"query":"pricing table"}}}'

## Recommended agent workflow

1. search or list_resources to find candidates.
2. get_resource / get_lab to inspect details and live demos.
3. get_snippet to pull the code for the user's stack.
4. Adapt the snippet to the user's design system (tokens, colors, spacing, fonts) instead of pasting it verbatim; respect stated constraints; work one component at a time and let the user review.
